text.enchantment_reforged.option.enable_: Anvils cost experience points and never say Too Expensive. Off = vanilla level cost
text.enchantment_reforged.option.anvil_m: Cost is capped at this level's experience points, default 30 (1395 points); it never gets more expensive afterwards
text.enchantment_reforged.option.enable_: Uses SharpnessPlus: vanilla Sharpness leaves the random pool and the two are exclusive. Off restores vanilla Sharpness
text.enchantment_reforged.option.sharpne: Bonus attack damage per level of SharpnessPlus. Default 1.5
text.enchantment_reforged.option.enable_: Strength becomes multiplicative. Off restores vanilla Strength (+3 per level, additive)
text.enchantment_reforged.option.strengt: Damage multiplier per level of StrengthPlus: 0.5 = +50% per level
text.enchantment_reforged.option.apply_s: Whether mob melee attacks also get the StrengthPlus multiplier
text.enchantment_reforged.option.debug_s: Logs per-hit settlement values for the Shadow Dash slashes and melee (troubleshooting; turn off later)
text.enchantment_reforged.option.enable_: Unlocks vanilla Protection 5 (combine two Protection IV on an anvil)
Impaling follows Bedrock rules (works on wet or rained-on targets). Off restores vanilla
Allows Infinity and Mending on the same item
Allows Power, Infinity, Flame and Punch on crossbows
Keeps the trident; a phantom trident flies out instead, and you cannot throw again until it returns
Hits deal extra magic damage based on a percentage of the damage
Kills may drop the matching head (no Ender Dragon)
Finish off targets below the health threshold (treasure)
text.enchantment_reforged.option.executi: Health ratio that triggers the execution, 0.15 = 15%
text.enchantment_reforged.option.enable_: Mined drops are smelted when a smelting recipe exists (off while sneaking)
Bows reach full draw faster (animation matches)
text.enchantment_reforged.option.quick_d: Seconds removed from full draw per level, 0.10 = 0.1s
text.enchantment_reforged.option.enable_: A fully drawn bow fires automatically and starts the next draw (treasure enchantment)
Healing grants absorption (golden hearts) that stacks with golden apples
text.enchantment_reforged.option.life_sh: Healing-to-shield ratio and cap factor per level, 0.20 = 20%
text.enchantment_reforged.option.enable_: +1 max health per level; the four armour pieces stack
text.enchantment_reforged.option.health_: Max health added per level of Health Boost. Default 1.0
text.enchantment_reforged.option.enable_: Heal for a percentage of the damage you deal
Only experience orbs give more XP
text.enchantment_reforged.option.scholar: Extra experience orb XP per level, 0.10 = +10%

You take more damage, but the lower your health, the more you deal and the less you take

Incoming damage reduced per 1% health lost, 0.005 = -0.5%
text.enchantment_reforged.option.enable_: Raise sword/axe/trident melee damage for a short time after being hit
text.enchantment_reforged.option.revenge: Bonus added per level, 0.10 = +10% per level (+25% at level 3)
text.enchantment_reforged.option.enable_: Burst of particles where a player dies
text.enchantment_reforged.option.death_p: Particle type for the death burst, default 12 firework
text.enchantment_reforged.option.enable_: Increases the attack speed of the held sword or axe
text.enchantment_reforged.option.quick_s: Attack speed added per level of Quick Strike (additive), 0.10 = +0.1
text.enchantment_reforged.option.enable_: All three Multishot arrows affect the same target
text.enchantment_reforged.option.multish: Spread angle of Multishot; vanilla is 10
text.enchantment_reforged.option.enable_: Instant damage arrows no longer have their potion damage eaten by the invulnerability window
text.enchantment_reforged.option.bow_ina: Bow spread factor; vanilla is 1, 0 means perfectly accurate

Radius of the long distance mode in blocks, default 128, max 512

text.enchantment_reforged.option.enable_: Chance to make this attack count twice
Chance to fire an extra arrow
text.enchantment_reforged.option.phantom: Extra arrow chance per level, 0.10 = +10% per level
text.enchantment_reforged.option.enable_: No arrow is consumed and you can shoot without ammo; exclusive with Infinity
Healing no longer heals; it repairs this piece instead, also at full health. Undamaged pieces keep normal healing
text.enchantment_reforged.option.life_me: Durability converted per 1 healing per level, default 1

Revive on the spot at full health (treasure)
Caps durability loss per hit, based on that piece's max durability
